name: plant-based-info
description: Single-page plant-based nutrition reference. Builds to one self-contained HTML file.

scripts.compile: npm run compile:js && npm run compile:css
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run compile && npm run build && node test/tools.mjs && node test/smoke.mjs
scripts.serve: npm run compile && npm run build && node -e "import('node:http').then(({default:h})=>import('node:fs').then(({readFileSync})=>h.createServer((q,s)=>{s.setHeader('content-type','text/html');s.end(readFileSync('index.html'))}).listen(8080,()=>console.log('http://localhost:8080'))))"
